entries.title: The explorer: every race as one dot, regrouped by one control

values.label: default: opens as one pile of all 165 races that splits into the series rows on a clock
opens on the single pile (All races) and leaves the split to the visitor

entries.look: Open More from the archive → The explorer. Watch the pile split into series, then flip Series / Season / Track / Weather and watch the dots travel. Hover a dot (INDY NXT ones carry the 3D still), click a group's name (try INDY NXT, then Track: ovals against road courses), click × to let go. Start → finish is gone: Qualifying to the flag and Biggest climbs carry it.
